items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and reject new monetization, spending, and implementation admissions this cycle. Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the $4.92 aggregate row uses tracking_id other and cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. Therefore revenue, contribution margin, ROI, forecasts, and causal lift are unsupported. AI usage from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 is $988.91 across 5,470 calls, including 233 errors; this is the only quantified operating cost in the brief. The reported site margins are AI-cost-only and are not contribution margins.

Minimum finance measurement before any ROI or profitability claim: a period-aligned ledger keyed by site, registered affiliate ID, and work item, containing attributed revenue, AI cost, infrastructure/hosting/domain cost, labor allocation, and an approved cost-to-learn threshold. Contribution margin and cost-to-learn are not calculable now because infrastructure, domain/hosting, labor, experiment cost allocation, and learning outcomes are absent. Budget exposure is also not calculable because monthly spend, fixed-cost, marketing-budget, and revenue-floor fields are blank. Preserve the existing $988.91 AI spend as observed exposure only; do not infer a budget variance or forecast.
